layers.name: gold_calibrated_physics_ml_blend
layers.method: gold overlay on the stage-2 blend: TVT_blend = weight*PF + (1-weight)*ML, then a per-well visible-prefix self-verified move (src/calibrate.py gold_calibrate_trajectory). Each well backtests candidates {blend,pf,ml,poly,beam} on withheld tails of its own known heel; a conservative gate (min_gain>=1.0 / min_consistency>=0.67 / max_best<=12) turns the evidence into a soft, ramped, clipped move applied only to the hidden toe. PF = numpy likelihood-weighted ensemble, ML = offline distilled GBRT (src/ml_predictor.py), beam = beam-search + multi-scale NCC GR<->typewell alignment (src/align.py); degrades to blend then to whichever side is finite
layers.beam_candidate: SOT-2442: +-2-delta beam search (backward-allowed Viterbi) aligning U=TVT+Z to the typewell GR-vs-TVT signature, plus a multi-scale NCC (windows 8/15/25, softmax x3.0) global TVT registration measured leak-free on the known heel. numpy-only, __file__-independent, deterministic (no RNG); averaged over ALIGN_CONFIGS. src/align.py predict_beam_well, byte-identical in the kernel (tests/test_align.py)
layers.blend_weight_selection: grid 0.50..1.00 argmin RMSE on leak-free fold-1 toe-holdout (disjoint from fold-0 confirm), frozen before reading fold-0 targets
layers.gold_profile_provenance: reference kernel evgendvorkin/rogii-physics-lb-7-872-v48 conservative ROGII_GOLD_* profile (not tuned on our gate); thresholds frozen in src/calibrate.py GOLD_PROFILE
